verdict: All sixteen acceptance criteria pass under execution, not inspection. node --check passes on both files; a no-DOM, no-bridge import registers window.MythicTransport and window.__mtr, prints the absent-bridge warning EXACTLY once across many B() calls, returns {ok:false,why:'Freight is not wired up on this build.'} from onCharterFounded twice in a row, and degrades open()/paint()/close() to false instead of throwing. The NULL_BRIDGE key set diffs clean against window.MythicTransportBridge at index.html:207827 (36 keys each; only _null extra, and the real side's `cloud` is a `get cloud()` accessor). Every mutator on NULL_BRIDGE returns false, with the departure from community.bridge.js's addGems:()=>{} argued from the measured 50,000-Cinder incident. The globals-trap grep returns only comment text and bridge property names. No .from(/.rpc(, no discord/webhook/FormData/createObjectURL. The two defects the builder claims to have closed are structurally closed and verified: registrationFields() is the single feeder for both registerRig() sites (seedStarter and act==='register'), and rigRowId() is the only vehicle-id -> rig-row-uuid crossing, used before repair() reaches sql/038:1307's p_rig_id uuid. The four self-audited defects also check out against their sibling files: effectiveRuns() already folds runsPerDayBonus (rigs.data.js:410), the displayed runs are min(ladder, stored) so the panel never over-promises against a runs_cap transport_repair does not update, quoteRequest now supplies nodes/carrier/carriers exactly as routes.js resolveInput() reads them, tariffOf() unwraps the JSONB sheet, and depotBlock() calls fleetCap(0) so the Garage slot lands once. Spot-checked citations to index.html and sql/038 are accurate at the revision they were written against (207415 MythicCityBridge, 207446 the 50k-Cinder swallow, 164225 _garageRig, 71039 getTodayKey, 39231 RARITIES, sql 276/1031/1033/1307/1357).
biggest_gap: quoteRequest()'s comment asserts a server mechanism that does not exist: 'sql/038's transport_dispatch re-derives all three from the rig it actually claims' and 'a better rig only ever makes the real haul faster and safer'. transport_quote computes risk as least(max_risk_pct, ceil(hops * risk_pct_per_hop)) and eta as hops * minutes_per_hop with no rig term anywhere (sql/038:767, :814-815), and routes.js says so from the other side in as many words — drift R1, 'Resolved, returned, applied to nothing', 'AND NOTHING MULTIPLIES BY IT TODAY'. So the paragraph justifies passing rigCargo/rigSpeed/rigRisk by a mechanism the migration contradicts. It compounds: for a self-haul it passes the PAID GARAGE rig's load/speed/risk as the pricing rig, while ownRigRowId() hands the server a Cinder PP fleet rig row to actually claim the run on. That is inert today only because routes.js applies none of the three; the moment a rig term is added it prices a fleet haul off the real-money rail, which is the separate-rail decision inverted by a wiring nobody would re-read. Fix: state drift R1 by name, say the three are carried for shape and applied to nothing, and take the multipliers off the fleet rig rather than off garageRig() for self-haul.

builder_response: The gap was registerRig() being called without rarity/condition/runsCap at index.js:490 and :636, plus repair() being handed a vehicle id where sql/038:1307 declares p_rig_id uuid. Both are closed, and closed structurally rather than by patching two lines: one registrationFields() helper now feeds both registration sites (so a third site cannot reintroduce the hole), and one rigRowId() is the single crossing between the vehicle-id domain and the rig-row-uuid domain, with the header promoting that distinction to a named hazard. I did not take the fix on trust — a harness with a fake Supabase client shows the Mythic insert carrying runs_cap 10 instead of defaulting to 3, and the repair click carrying data-mt-id="v_alpha" arriving at the RPC as p_rig_id "rig-uuid-1". Auditing the same class then found four more live defects of my own making, which I also fixed and verified: the Garage run bonus was double-counted (effectiveRuns already folds it in), displayed runs over-promised against the stored runs_cap that transport_repair never updates, the quote request was missing nodes/carrier/carriers so no player quote could ever price and every refusal was stored as a live quote, and carrier tariffs are JSONB so Number(row.tariff) was NaN — which printed every rate as 0 and collapsed the exchange ceiling to the floor.
